info.title: Forge Server Runtime API
info.description: Authenticated loopback API for one explicit Forge Server instance. Only origin-form request targets are routed; absolute URLs, authority-bearing paths, fragments and control characters are rejected. Repeated Authorization or Content-Length headers, non-decimal lengths, truncated bodies and Transfer-Encoding request framing are rejected before service dispatch. Forge business semantics remain owned by application services.

get.summary: Read the installed Server's project-DAG HTTP capability subset
get.description: Authenticated capability support is not project-binding or execution readiness. This response describes only the existing project list and repository-scoped Mission/Action roadmap reads; project Mission attribution, capability graph and Candidate/Expected views remain unavailable.

A separately issued Workspace read bearer is limited to this GET and GET /v1/instance. Its 200 response includes workspace_read_scope; the exact typed response is workspace-status-read-v1.json#/$defs/status. The ordinary Server bearer remains a distinct administrator credential.

403.description: Workspace read bearer is outside its route scope

get.summary: Read the persisted Mission and Action DAG subset for one configured project
get.description: The repository scope reports exact active Mission IDs/count and NONE, SINGLE or UNSUPPORTED_MULTIPLE cardinality, plus per-Mission recorded-transition source times and freshness. Aggregate freshness is UNKNOWN when any Mission timeline is missing or malformed, and is never refreshed merely by reopening the runtime. These fields do not claim project membership or parallel execution. Capability, Candidate, Expected and cross-Mission project graph views remain unavailable. No peer call or Mission mutation occurs.

workspaceReadBearer.description: Separate instance and configured-repository bound read grant for GET /v1/instance and GET /v1/status only

workspaceReviewBearer.description: Separate owner-issued, revocable, expiring instance/principal/Mission/role-scoped review grant. Never an administrator or status read bearer.

workspaceWorklistBearer.description: Separate explicit workset read capability; no status/review/admin rights.

workspaceWorklistControlBearer.description: Separate owner-issued instance/principal/exact-workset expiring hold/unhold command capability. Scoped current/operation readback only; no administrator, status/review/read grant upgrade.

advisoryBearer.description: Separate owner-issued exact instance/principal/project/repository/conversation capability. No approval/admin authority.

AdvisoryCandidateGrant.description: Separate owner-issued conversation/proposal Candidate-only grant; no approval or execution.

CandidateDecisionGrant.description: Separate owner-provisioned exact Candidate/revision READ and Business/Architecture permissions, bound to current existing G001 operator role; no Mission/admin/other namespace authority.

missionFinalAcceptanceBearer.description: Separately owner-issued finite exact-Mission READ/ACCEPT capability. Current Business role/G001 required at actual effects. Prior read/progression/Candidate/hold/workset/admin credentials do not authorize this route.

worksetOrderBearer.description: Distinct finite owner-issued READ/REORDER for exact original worksets; actual current Solo Business and Architecture roles required.

worksetActivityBearer.description: Finite current scoped READ; explicit workset grant pattern and owner-provisioned private cursor capability; no mutation permission.

projectProposalBearer.description: Finite current owner-issued private proposal PREPARE/READ, explicit audience and dossier. Old/admin credentials rejected.

conceptAdvisoryBearer.description: Distinct finite owner-issued pre-project READ/ADVISE with principal/audience/dossier/conversation/current transfer/provider binding; no approval or R52 rights.
